round 1: a refresh in flight at logout could refill the cache; write lock + clear epoch drops it
round 1: SSE tests passed without change events; now exact per-route load counts on an open stream
round 1: double load on screen start; first connection no longer reloads, only reconnects
round 1: SQLiteException during refresh broke the flow; mapped to Failed(null)
round 1: rows could be emitted with refreshedAt null; rows+meta now read in one transaction
